items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. I'm the first one to book Ray Charles on a concert.

ctx.x: Yeah. I'm the first one to book Ray Charles on a concert. Because I used to go to all his dances to hear what he was doing. You know? Because the guy had such good records, and I wanted to see how he was performing. He always had a good band. But I just noticed in all the places I went, I never seen no well-dressed people in there. So the idea come to me to book him on a concert. So that way, the well-dressed people could buy tickets and go to a concert hall.
